content.text: Let me fetch all pages via eval using the page link hrefs.

input.command: orca eval --expression "(async()=>{const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].map(a=>a.href);const hrefs=[location.href,...new Set(links.filter(h=>/\d/.test(h)))];const rows=[];for(const h of hrefs){const t=await (await fetch(h)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');d.querySelectorAll('tbody tr, table tr').forEach(r=>{const c=[...r.querySelectorAll('td')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim());if(c.length)rows.push(c.join('|'))});}const u=[...new Set(rows)];return JSON.stringify({hrefs,n:u.length,rows:u.filter(r=>/northwind/i.test(r))})})()" --json
input.description: Fetch all pages and extract Northwind rows
